description: The chart illustrates the distribution of samples across different levels of sample-level ambiguity standard deviation and sample-level maximum ambiguity, presented in a nested pie chart format with an inner and outer ring. The chart is divided into a total of 7 slices, with the outer ring representing 4 categories labeled as "Std: 0.0," "Std: 0.47," "Std: 0.82," and "Std: 0.94," colored in distinct shades of blue, occupying approximately 7.0%, 47.7%, 38.0%, and 7.3% of the chart, respectively. The inner ring represents 3 categories labeled as "Max: 1," "Max: 2," and "Max: 3," also colored in different shades of blue, occupying approximately 14.2%, 39.0%, and 49.0% of the chart, respectively. The percentage labels are displayed directly on the chart, and a legend is provided to the right, clarifying the color coding for both the inner and outer rings. The slices are not visually emphasized or exploded, and the segments appear to be ordered in a particular color gradient.
